description: This file contains a class 'AppIdentityDbContextSeed' with a static method 'SeedAsync' that initializes the identity database context with default users and roles, including creating roles, a default user, and an admin user, with role assignments.

classes.name: AppIdentityDbContextSeed
classes.description: A utility class for seeding the identity database with default users and roles.

methods.name: SeedAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously seeds the identity database with default role, user, and admin user, performing migrations if required.
